types.name: ActionQueue

fields.name: manager
fields.comment: high: ctor 4f320 stores GetActionQueueManager() result; ~ActionQueue 4f1b0 passes [this] as ECX to UnRegisterQueue 4f440. PS2 +0x0 (Initialize/~ActionQueue). Name invented

fields.name: count
fields.comment: high: IsEmpty 4f220 returns [+4]==0; PopAction 4f250 decrements when >0; GetAction 4f290 tests >0; Flush 4f280 zeroes; buffer ctor 4f2d0 zeroes. PS2 +0x4 IsEmpty. Name invented

fields.name: tail
fields.comment: medium: ring write index: 4f2d0/ctor/Flush set -1; advanced by ReceiveAction's helper 4f1c0. PS2 +0x8 Flush. Name invented

fields.name: head
fields.comment: high: ring read index: GetAction reads entry at this+0x14+head*0xc; PopAction head++ and wraps to 0 when > capacity-1; Flush zeroes. Name invented

fields.name: capacity
fields.comment: high: 4f2d0 stores 0xc8 (200); PopAction reads it for the wrap. Name invented

fields.name: actions
fields.comment: high: 4f2d0 constructs 200 x 12-byte entries (4f170(0,0,0)) from this+0x14 to 0x974; GetAction copies one out via a1ec0. PS2 ctors LEA +0x14. Name invented

types.comment: No vptr. Manager pointer + an embedded fixed ring buffer of 200 ActionData (12 bytes each). Ctor 4f320 runs the buffer ctor 4f2d0 on this+4 (loop of 200 x 4f170 over +0x14, stride 0xc), then GetActionQueueManager and RegisterQueue(this). Allocated with operator new(0x974) by PHelicopter/PBondCar/SWeaponManager/SMissionManager/RWorldCamera. Offsets identical on PS2.

Mapping Xbox->PS2: +0x10..+0x1c -> +0x34..+0x40, +0x20 -> +0x44, +0x24/+0x28 -> +0x4c/+0x50, +0x2c -> +0x54, +0x30 -> +0x58.

types.comment: 1-slot vtable (deleting dtor 11b650). PS2 puts the vptr last (+4) and the map pointer at +0; Xbox vptr +0, map pointer +4. The namespace map is a heap-allocated 12-byte MSVC tree (map<name, Namespace*>): ctor FastAllocs 0xc, deleting dtor frees 0xc then 8.

PS2 vptr is LAST (+0x90), so Xbox fields are PS2 + 4. Size inferred: PS2 0x94 (splitter +0x2c..+0x90, vptr +0x90); Xbox ctor writes up to +0x8c. Embedded GSubtitleSplitter at +0x30 taken as 0x60 on Xbox (0x64 on PS2, one bool packed); the ctor writes at +0x80/+0x88/+0x8c are then its inlined member inits.
